name: THE DARK FAE WHO WORSHIPS ME
original_name: THE DARK FAE WHO WORSHIPS ME
overview:
Buried alive by the man she trusted most, a Hollywood star makes a deal with an immortal Dark Druid. She gains the power to destroy everyone who betrayed her—but their souls become bound together. What begins as revenge slowly becomes a love written across centuries.

Some destinies demand far more than a happy ending.
